title: That Night
summary: A full cinematic flashback to the fateful rainy night seven years ago, revealing Tae-Jun's bloody last stand in the apartment corridors to protect young Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: black and white title card with rain streaks
panels.action: A stark monochrome screen reads: 'SEVEN YEARS AGO — OCTOBER 14'. Rain streaks slide down the glass.
panels.prose_en: A stark monochrome screen reads: 'SEVEN YEARS AGO — OCTOBER 14'. Rain streaks slide down the glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ek spasht monochrome screen par likha hai: 'saat saal pehle - 14 octuber'. baarish ki dhariyan sheeshe se neeche sarakti han.

panels.shot: 10-year-old ha-jun shivering under duvet in bed
panels.action: A small 10-year-old Ha-Jun pulls his star-patterned quilt up to his chin, trembling at the roaring thunder outside.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Toofan bohot tez hai... Mummy Papa abhi tak ghar kyun nahi aaye?

panels.prose_en: A small 10-year-old Ha-Jun pulls his star-patterned quilt up to his chin, trembling at the roaring thunder outside.
panels.prose_hi: Ek chhota Dus saal ka chhota Ha-Jun apni sitara-patern wali rajai ko apni thodi tak khinchta hai, aur bahar ki tez gadgdahat se kampta hai.

panels.shot: 15-year-old tae-jun sitting by ha-jun bed softly smiling
panels.action: 15-year-old Tae-Jun sits on the bedside edge, wearing a warm grey wool sweater, gently stroking Ha-Jun's hair.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Daro mat, Ha-Jun. Main hoon na. Jab tak main yahan hoon, koi toofan tumhe chhu nahi sakta.

panels.prose_en: 15-year-old Tae-Jun sits on the bedside edge, wearing a warm grey wool sweater, gently stroking Ha-Jun's hair.
panels.prose_hi: 15 varshiya Tae-Jun, garm grey uni sweater pahane hue, bistar ke kinare par baithi hai, dheere se Ha-Jun ke baalon ko sahala rahi hai.

panels.shot: distant sound of glass shattering downstairs in apartment lobby
panels.action: A sudden muffled CRASH echoes from the lobby four floors down, followed by guttural, wet snarling.
panels.prose_en: A sudden muffled CRASH echoes from the lobby four floors down, followed by guttural, wet snarling.
panels.prose_hi: Char manjil neeche lobby se achanak dabi-dabi si durghatna ki awaz gunjati hai, jiske baad goonjati, bhigi-bhini cheekh sunai deti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun eyes instantly hardening with razor sharpness
panels.action: Tae-Jun's gentle smile vanishes; his jaw clenches and his eyes flare with a fierce bronze demonic ward-light.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's gentle smile vanishes; his jaw clenches and his eyes flare with a fierce bronze demonic ward-light.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ki saumya muskan gayab ho gai; uska jabda bhinch jata hai aur uski aankhen bhayankar kansya shaitani demonic vard-light se chamak uthti han.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking toward the closed bedroom door listening
panels.action: Tae-Jun tilts his head; his heightened demonic senses pick up the tactical boot-steps of six armed men in the hallway.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun tilts his head; his heightened demonic senses pick up the tactical boot-steps of six armed men in the hallway.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apna sir jhukata hai; uski badhi hui shaitani indriyan dalan mein chhah hathiyarband logon ke samrik boot-staps ko pakad leti han.

panels.shot: tae-jun pulling the blanket gently over ha-jun eyes
panels.action: Tae-Jun tucks the blanket over Ha-Jun's shoulders: 'Ha-Jun, play our secret game. Keep your eyes closed until I say.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Secret hide-and-seek game yaad hai? Aankhein band rakho aur 500 tak count karo. No matter what.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun tucks the blanket over Ha-Jun's shoulders: 'Ha-Jun, play our secret game. Keep your eyes closed until I say.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne Ha-Jun ke kandhon par kambal dala: 'Ha-Jun, hamara gupt khel khelo. jab tak main na kahoon tab tak apni aankhen band rakhna.'

panels.shot: young ha-jun nodding innocently closing his eyes
panels.action: Young Ha-Jun smiles trustingly, shutting his brown eyes tight: 'One... two... three...'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hyung hamesha game jeetta hai... Main iss baar pakka jeetunga.

panels.prose_en: Young Ha-Jun smiles trustingly, shutting his brown eyes tight: 'One... two... three...'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota Ha-Jun apni bhuri aankhon ko kas kar band karte hue, bharosemand dhang se muskurata hai: 'ek... do... teen...'.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping out into hallway pulling door shut
panels.action: Tae-Jun steps into the dark apartment hallway and pulls Ha-Jun's bedroom door shut with a quiet click.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun steps into the dark apartment hallway and pulls Ha-Jun's bedroom door shut with a quiet click.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun andhere apartment ke dalan mein kadam rakhta hai aur Ha-Jun ke shyankaksh ke darvaje ko ek halki si click ke saath band kar deta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun slicing his own palm with a silver penknife
panels.action: Tae-Jun draws a sharp silver blade across his right palm; dark crimson blood with golden sparks pools in his hand.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun draws a sharp silver blade across his right palm; dark crimson blood with golden sparks pools in his hand.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apni dahini hatheli par ek tej chandi ka blade khinchta hai; uske haath mein sunhari chingariyon wala gehra lal rang ka khoon hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun painting an ancient guardian seal on the bedroom door
panels.action: With his bleeding fingers, Tae-Jun paints a complex celestial ward across the doorframe: 'Aegis of the Silent Child'.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Mere khoon ki aakhri boond tak... Yeh darwaza kisi shaitan ke liye nahi khulega.

panels.prose_en: With his bleeding fingers, Tae-Jun paints a complex celestial ward across the doorframe: 'Aegis of the Silent Child'.
panels.prose_hi: Apni lahuluhan ungaliyon se, Tae-Jun ne darvaje ki chaukhat ke paar ek jatil khagoliya ward chitrit kiya: 'agis off the silent child'.

panels.shot: apartment front door blowing off its hinges in explosion
panels.action: The front door is blown inward with plastic explosives; smoke, wood splinters, and rain pour into the living room.
panels.prose_en: The front door is blown inward with plastic explosives; smoke, wood splinters, and rain pour into the living room.
panels.prose_hi: Samne ka darwaza plastic visphotakon se andar ki or uda diya gaya hai; dhuan, lakdi ke tukde aur baarish living room mein fail jaati hai.

panels.shot: three section 9 cyber-hunters entering with assault rifles
panels.action: Three operatives in matte-black tactical exosuits and glowing red night-vision visors enter with rifles raised.
panels.prose_en: Three operatives in matte-black tactical exosuits and glowing red night-vision visors enter with rifles raised.
panels.prose_hi: Mat-black tactical exosuit aur chamakdar lal night-vizan wiser pahane teen karyakarta riflein uthaye hue pravesh karte han.

panels.shot: a hulking four-legged chimera hound bounding through the breach
panels.action: Behind them leaps a snarling bio-mechanical chimera hound with razor metal fangs and dripping toxic saliva.
panels.prose_en: Behind them leaps a snarling bio-mechanical chimera hound with razor metal fangs and dripping toxic saliva.
panels.prose_hi: Unke peeche razor lohe ke nukile daanton aur tapakti jahrili lar ke saath ek gurrata jaiv-yantrik chimera shikari kutta chhalang lagata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun standing alone in the narrow hallway wielding bronze dagger
panels.action: 15-year-old Tae-Jun stands alone in his wool sweater, holding his bronze dagger as bronze mana coats his body like armor.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Tum galat ghar mein ghus gaye ho.

panels.prose_en: 15-year-old Tae-Jun stands alone in his wool sweater, holding his bronze dagger as bronze mana coats his body like armor.
panels.prose_hi: 15 varshiya Tae-Jun apne uni sweater mein akela khada hai, apne kansya khanjar ko pakde hue hai kyonki kansya man uske shareer ko kavach ki tarah dhakta hai.

panels.shot: lead hunter barking orders: 'capture subject zero alive!'
panels.action: The lead hunter barks through a voice vocoder: 'Subject Zero located! Don't damage the brainstem!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_leader
dialogue.text: Fire suppressive rounds! Harvest him for Dr. Vance!

panels.prose_en: The lead hunter barks through a voice vocoder: 'Subject Zero located! Don't damage the brainstem!'.
panels.prose_hi: Mukhya shikari voice vocoder ke madhyam se bhaunkta hai: 'vishay shunya sthit hai! dimag ko nuksan mat pahunchao!'

panels.shot: storm of automatic gunfire erupting down the hallway
panels.action: Muzzle flashes light up the narrow walls as high-caliber armor-piercing bullets shred the drywall.
panels.prose_en: Muzzle flashes light up the narrow walls as high-caliber armor-piercing bullets shred the drywall.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi ucch-kshamta wali kavch-bhedi goliyan drywall ko tukde-tukde kar deti han, thuthan ki chamak sankirna diwaron ko roshan kar deti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun deflecting bullets with bronze mana barrier
panels.action: Tae-Jun thrusts his palm forward; a semi-translucent bronze shield deflects bullets into the ceiling and floor.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun thrusts his palm forward; a semi-translucent bronze shield deflects bullets into the ceiling and floor.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apni hatheli aage badhata hai; ek ardh-pardarshi kansya dhal chhat aur farsh mein goliyon ko vikshepit karti hai.

panels.shot: chimera hound lunging at tae-jun throat
panels.action: The chimera beast leaps through the gunfire, its metal jaws snapping directly toward Tae-Jun's neck.
panels.prose_en: The chimera beast leaps through the gunfire, its metal jaws snapping directly toward Tae-Jun's neck.
panels.prose_hi: Chimera janwar bandook ki goli ke beech se chhalang lagata hai, uske lohe ke jabde sidhe Tae-Jun ki gardan ki or badhte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun ducking and driving dagger through beast jaw
panels.action: Tae-Jun drops under the beast's leap and drives his bronze blade upward through its lower jaw into its brain.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun drops under the beast's leap and drives his bronze blade upward through its lower jaw into its brain.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun janwar ki chhalang ke neeche gir jata hai aur apne kansya blade ko uske nichle jabde ke madhyam se uske mastishk mein upar ki or le jata hai.

panels.shot: chimera beast crashing dead onto hallway carpet
panels.action: The heavy cyber-hound hits the floor, thrashing once before black oil-blood pools beneath it.
panels.prose_en: The heavy cyber-hound hits the floor, thrashing once before black oil-blood pools beneath it.
panels.prose_hi: Bhari cyber-hound farsh se takrata hai, uske neeche kale tel-khoon pool se pehle ek baar dhadkata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun sprinting directly into the living room squad
panels.action: Tae-Jun doesn't retreat; he sprints straight into the three hunters to draw the fight away from Ha-Jun's room.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun doesn't retreat; he sprints straight into the three hunters to draw the fight away from Ha-Jun's room.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun peeche nahin hatta; wah Ha-Jun ke kamre se ladai ko door karne ke liye sidhe teen shikariyon ke paas jata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun disarming first hunter with elbow strike
panels.action: Tae-Jun shatters the first operative's rifle with a reinforced elbow strike and hurls him into the coffee table.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun shatters the first operative's rifle with a reinforced elbow strike and hurls him into the coffee table.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne pehle operative ki rifle ko kohni ke jordar prahar se chaknachur kar diya aur use coffee table par fenk diya.

panels.shot: second hunter stabbing high-voltage stun baton into tae-jun side
panels.action: A second operative drives an electrified baton into Tae-Jun's ribs, discharging 50,000 volts of blue lightning.
panels.prose_en: A second operative drives an electrified baton into Tae-Jun's ribs, discharging 50,000 volts of blue lightning.
panels.prose_hi: Ek dusra sanchalak Tae-Jun ki pasliyon mein ek vidyutikrit danda chalata hai, jisse 50,000 volt ki neeli bijli nikalti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun roaring and snapping the baton with bare hands
panels.action: Veins bulging on his neck, Tae-Jun refuses to fall; he grabs the electrified rod and snaps the titanium shaft in half.
panels.prose_en: Veins bulging on his neck, Tae-Jun refuses to fall; he grabs the electrified rod and snaps the titanium shaft in half.
panels.prose_hi: Uski gardan par ubhari hui nasen, Tae-Jun girne se inkar karta hai; wah vidyutikrit chhad ko pakad leta hai aur titanium shaft ko aadha tod deta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun punching operative through the shattered window
panels.action: With a terrifying burst of bronze mana, Tae-Jun hurls the hunter clean through the 4th-floor window into the rain.
panels.prose_en: With a terrifying burst of bronze mana, Tae-Jun hurls the hunter clean through the 4th-floor window into the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Kansya maina ke ek bhayanak visfot ke sath, Tae-Jun ne shikari ko chauthi manjil ki khidki se baarish mein fenk diya.

panels.shot: tae-jun standing bloodied and gasping in the ruined living room
panels.action: Smoke drifts; Tae-Jun stands panting, blood dripping from his sweater and knuckles onto the shattered glass.
panels.prose_en: Smoke drifts; Tae-Jun stands panting, blood dripping from his sweater and knuckles onto the shattered glass.
panels.prose_hi: Dhuan bahta hai; Tae-Jun hanfta hua khada hai, uske sweater se khoon tapak raha hai aur toote sheeshe par por gir raha hai.

panels.shot: outside window: four more tactical black vans screeching to halt
panels.action: Down on the rainy street, four more Section 9 armored transport vans pull up with fifty armed reinforcements.
panels.prose_en: Down on the rainy street, four more Section 9 armored transport vans pull up with fifty armed reinforcements.
panels.prose_hi: Niche barsati sadak par, char aur dhara 9 bakhtarband parivahan van pachas sashastra sudridhikaran ke saath aati han.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking back one last time at ha-jun closed door
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks down the dark hallway at Ha-Jun's closed bedroom door, glowing faintly with his blood ward.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Agar main yahan ruka... Wo pura building blast kar denge. Tujhe jeena hoga, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun looks down the dark hallway at Ha-Jun's closed bedroom door, glowing faintly with his blood ward.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun Ha-Jun ke band shyankaksh ke andhere galiyare se neeche dekhta hai, jahan uska khoon ward halki si chamak raha hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun leaping out into the rainy night to lead them away
panels.action: Tae-Jun vaults off the broken window ledge into the torrential downpour, igniting his mana flare to lure the entire army.

dialogue.text: Aur uss raat ke baad... Ha-Jun ne apne bhai ko dobara kabhi nahi dekha.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun vaults off the broken window ledge into the torrential downpour, igniting his mana flare to lure the entire army.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun puri sena ko lubhane ke liye apni man ki jwala ko prajvalit karte hue, musladhar baarish mein tuti hui khidki ke kinare se bahar nikalta hai.
